# Change description

Describe the concrete input/behaviour change and its owning boundary. Distinguish planned capability declarations from implemented support.

# Verification

Record actual public command/file/process evidence, strict types/native documentation, meaningful statement and branch coverage, licence/provenance checks, workflow/tool alignment and applicable independent review. Explain unresolved gates and rollback behaviour. Keep private inputs and working records out of the diff.
